sdk-0.1.requirement: Canonical SDK declarations compile in strict TypeScript.
Schema overload returns required inferred data and plain act does not.
Async describe callbacks are rejected by the type surface.
Every canonical example type-checks without implementation-only types.
Setup-only and ordinary fixture authority remain type-distinct.
Backend handles and secret handles are nominal and nonforgeable.

runner-0.1.requirement: Project/config discovery, unknown-key rejection, and precedence are deterministic.
Glob matching follows the frozen grammar and ordering.
Effective URL, environment, origin, model, and limit validation fail before execution.
Modules register synchronously and exports never cause collection or duplication.
Stable test/setup/serial IDs and duplicate detection match the specified encoding.
File, tag, target, platform, capability, only, skip, and zero-test selection match the algorithm.
Session producers and serial closure are selected statically and atomically.
Nested hook order, entered-scope teardown, and primary/secondary errors are exact.
Independent attempts receive fresh logical backend, fixture, handler, ledger, and artifact state.
Retry eligibility, realm replacement, and flaky outcome match the transition table.
Serial groups restore once, share state, retry from member one, and report every member attempt.
Timeout and signal cancellation propagate; forced realm death preserves host finalizers and partial results.
App process startup, safe environment, readiness, process-group shutdown, and force kill are bounded.
Flags, reporter behavior, unconditional JSON report, and exit precedence match the contract.
Prompt and tool injection cannot expand runner policy or execute unknown tools.
Origin, redirect, frame, scheme, DNS/IP, and HTTPS policy fail closed.
Credential handle, purpose, origin, revision, and destination checks precede plaintext resolution.
Secret taint removes pixel/video evidence and textual secret redaction remains complete.
The runner never claims to sandbox trusted code; untrusted execution requires an external no-secret boundary.
Terminal output escapes untrusted content and report paths enforce path and size policy.

core-0.1.requirement: Complete immutable locator AST preserves query, scope, frame, filters, and index.
Resolve/read are immediate; runner owns polling, strictness, and deadlines.
Ordering, descendant scope, conjunctive filters, and direct-read cardinality are exact.
Every public locator and agent action preserves normalized options.
Every mutator distinguishes precommit stale state from possibly committed failure.
Observation tree and optional screenshot share one revision and valid node references.
Secure values, input purpose, sensitive attributes, and screenshot taint satisfy policy.
State capture is complete for the profile and restore replaces rather than merges.
Artifact capabilities, containment, masking, limits, and finalization are exact.
Every operation and event decision honors timeout and abort without later mutation.

web-0.1.requirement: ARIA 1.2 roles and AccName 1.2 names match reference vectors.
Text normalization, regexp, hidden, state, and assertion semantics match vectors.
Web actionability and action timeout semantics match the profile.
Scroll/swipe distance, duration, direction, and no-progress termination are normalized.
Open, restart, clearState, back, deepLink, and screenshot state semantics are exact.
Navigation, redirects, wait states, URL matching, and origin checks are exact.
Frame AST, strict frame resolution, and cross-origin policy are exact.
Route grammar, ordering, one decision, errors, and cleanup match the profile.
Evaluation accepts only trusted source and JSON-safe arguments/results.
Cookies, viewport, secure reads, and session stores match the profile.
Dialogs and downloads register before triggers and cancel/clean deterministically.
Keyboard and trusted web mouse operations are bounded and reported.
The same required vectors pass pinned Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

driver-1.requirement: Branded handle exposes immutable identity, version, platforms, and capabilities before launch.
Launch is bounded and rolls back every partial acquisition on rejection.
Resolved app/query policy and operation context reach every required primitive.
Close is idempotent, uses fresh cleanup context, and leaves no owned work running.
Closed driver errors report retry and commit safety without assigning test status.
Route, dialog, and download event bridges preserve runner callback authority and cancellation.
Manifest capability and runtime capability fixtures agree exactly.
Verifier runs the reference app and emits artifact-bound conformance-1 reports.

agent-protocol-1.requirement: Every model tool call validates against one closed discriminated schema.
Each agent method receives only its documented tool subset and budget.
Model calls cannot submit coordinates, code, selectors, unknown fields, or policy changes.
Secret tool calls contain name/purpose only and require host authorization.
Conclusions, schema repair, repetition, timeout, and budget errors are runner-owned.
Judgment methods accept only boolean result and bounded explanation.

report-1.requirement: Positive and hostile report fixtures satisfy strict schema expectations.
Reference validator recomputes identity, order, status, summary, references, and usage.
All paths are relative POSIX, canonical, contained, and symlink safe.
Target, backend, model, policy, and environment provenance is complete.
Artifact producer, digest, size, redaction, and incomplete-evidence rules are exact.
Interrupted/error runs atomically produce valid bounded partial reports.
Hostile schema-valid reports cannot bypass semantic validation or renderer escaping.

trace-1.requirement: Entries validate strictly on read; any malformed, oversized, or truncated entry is a miss, never an error or a repair.
No secret plaintext ever enters an entry: fills are recorded by stable name and all recorded strings pass the run's redactor.
Keys bind project, test, target/backend/app identity, kind, instruction and params digests, occurrence index, and policy version.

Replay runs through the step's own grammar under identical deadline, budget, policy, and recording; a full replay self-finalizes as passed only while the recorded postcondition holds — the live pathname matches the recorded end path and every recorded end anchor is present again — and otherwise hands off with end-mismatch.

A passing step records as end anchors the relocatable descriptors on screen at its pass that were absent at its start, for a step that ended on the pathname it began on; anchors never carry secret plaintext or node values.

Any divergence hands the step to the executor mid-step with the replayedPrefix notice; a divergence is never a step failure, runtime hard stops are never divergence, and a consumed replay whose step settles non-passed evicts its entry.

Passing steps stage; staged traces settle at attempt end — confirmed only when a verification step (deterministic assertion, locator wait, or agent judgment) passed after them before any failure, evicted otherwise, untouched by interruption — and CI is forced read-only.

session-1.requirement: Session envelope and positive/hostile fixtures satisfy strict schema and expiry semantics.
AES-256-GCM uses random memory-only per-run key and authenticates all metadata.
Run, name, target, platform, backend version/SPI, app identity, and expiry all bind restore.
Only successful setup attempts atomically publish every declared output once.
Owner-only files are per-run, deleted on cleanup, and abandoned ciphertext is scavenged.

conformance-1.requirement: Conformance documents validate strictly and bind one exact profile/artifact/suite.
Every manifest ID appears exactly once and unknown, missing, duplicate, or skipped IDs fail.
Overall status is derived from requirement results.
Claims are accepted only after a trusted reference-suite rerun against the digest-pinned artifact.
